name: fsync

provenance.source: exact 4.100.139 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64; body shape identical to the reviewed 4.100.155 function and unique in this image

notes: NuttX fsync: resolves the descriptor, calls the inode's sync operation, returns -1 and sets errno on failure. The stock algorithm services call it after writing and log FsyncE on a negative result. Supervisor platform hardware service; static evidence only, device NOT_PROBED.
